content.text:
The drawing shows two phenyl groups (Ph) joined by a carbon–carbon triple bond. The molecule is diphenylacetylene (tolane).

Each Ph expands to a benzene ring, c1ccccc1, and the triple bond links the two ring carbons through two alkyne carbons. The SMILES is C(#Cc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1, which matches the drawing atom for atom. No stereochemistry applies.

SMILES: C(#Cc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1
